description: This file contains a PHP class implementing a database driver for Netezza within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It includes configuration details, SQL query templates, and methods specific to the Netezza database system, such as retrieving column metadata and handling data types.

classes.name: ADODB_netezza
classes.description: A PHP class extending the PostgreSQL driver to support Netezza-specific features and SQL dialect.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_netezza
classes.description: A class extending the PostgreSQL recordset class with Netezza-specific behavior, particularly for initialization.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table, supporting Netezza-specific system tables and data types.
